title: Current SIP/RTP baseline
summary: SIP v0.1-dev16 is the current signalling baseline and RTP v0.1-dev7 is the current shared media baseline. SIP now covers registrar/server behavior plus outbound INVITE/ACK/BYE client control.
invariants: SIP and RTP are separate components.
Outbound SIP client dialog control does not own RTP or audio worker lifecycle.
Twinkle REGISTER/OPTIONS behavior remains a regression boundary.
Known estate dependency heads must not be confused with source bytes actually used for a build.
